strings.im_a_developer_from_alexandria_working_a: I’m a developer from Alexandria working across web and mobile: HTML and PHP on one side, Flutter and Kotlin on the other. I build complete products from design to backend, with a focus on clean code and experiences that feel right.

strings.an_educational_platform_for_students_at_: An educational platform for students at Alexandria University’s Faculty of Commerce, with lectures, summaries, videos, a campus map, a timetable, and a GPA calculator. It also includes an admin dashboard with role-based access and department management. I built both the app and dashboard independently.

strings.an_educational_platform_with_three_apps_: An educational platform with three apps for students, administrators, and teachers. It manages students, teachers, and assistants, includes a subscription-code wallet, and uses a custom YouTube player designed to solve synchronization issues.
